content_sections.heading: AIIMS Guwahati Faculty Vacancy 2026 - Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: A total of 63 vacancies have been notified across four faculty grades. The vacancies are provisional and subject to variation at the discretion of the Executive Director, AIIMS Guwahati, and include backlog vacancies from previous recruitment cycles. Total Posts: 63 The 63 posts are spread across 31 departments at AIIMS Guwahati. The department-wise total number of vacancies (all four faculty grades combined) is given below. Grand Total: 63 Posts For the post of Professor in Trauma and Emergency Medicine (UR-1), the order of preference of specialty during selection is: Trauma Surgery (M.Ch.) Emergency Medicine Anaesthesiology with experience in critical care Orthopaedics with experience in trauma General Surgery with experience in trauma or Fellowship in Trauma care For the post of Assistant Professor in Trauma and Emergency Medicine (OBC-1), the specialty distribution is Obstetrics and Gynaecology.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Guwahati Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the prescribed educational qualification, experience, and age criteria as on the last date of submission of the online application (the applicable cut-off date). Both medical and non-medical candidates can apply for eligible disciplines. For non-medical candidates (Anatomy, Pharmacology, Microbiology, etc.), the requirement is a postgraduate degree in the relevant discipline along with a Doctorate degree from a recognized university, with teaching/research experience ranging from 3 years (Assistant Professor) to 14 years (Professor) depending on the post applied for. Candidates holding a DNB qualification must submit documentary evidence of DNB equivalence with MD/MS/DM/M.Ch as per the NMC (formerly MCI) notification dated 31.10.2018. Depending on the training institution, DNB candidates may need 1 to 2 years of additional experience. The upper age limit is calculated as on the last date of submission of the online application. Age relaxation is admissible as follows: No age relaxation is available to SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates applying against unreserved vacancies. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Guwahati Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances. Applications submitted without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Guwahati Faculty Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening of applications is done on the basis of the bio-data submitted by candidates. If a large number of candidates apply for a post, a screening test may be conducted to shortlist candidates for interview. Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview, where they must produce all original documents in support of the details furnished in their application. Candidates may also be required to submit an affidavit or declaration as decided by AIIMS Guwahati at the time of interview. Interviews will be held at AIIMS Guwahati or any other venue decided by the Executive Director. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview. The prescribed qualification is the minimum requirement; merely possessing it does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview or selection.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Guwahati Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AIIMS Guwahati has notified a total of 63 Group-A Faculty posts across 31 departments, comprising Professor, Additional Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application is 15.09.2026, and the last date for receipt of the hard copy of the application is 30.09.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for AIIMS Guwahati Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1,500/- for UR/OBC/EWS candidates. SC/ST/PwBD candidates and women candidates of all categories are exempted from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AIIMS Guwahati Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 58 years for Professor and Additional Professor posts, and 50 years for Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts, as on the last date of online application, with age relaxation applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for AIIMS Guwahati Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The minimum basic pay ranges from Rs. 1,01,500/- for Assistant Professor to Rs. 1,68,900/- for Professor, as per the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, plus Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) for medically qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for AIIMS Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to apply online through the official website https://aiimsguwahati.ac.in and then send the signed hard copy of the application with self-attested documents to the Administrative Officer, AIIMS Guwahati, within the stipulated period.
